top_signals.title: Trump Casts Doubt on New Iran Negotiations as War Drags On
top_signals.summary: Retired Army General Wesley Clark, who served as Supreme Allied Commander Europe, said the more the US wants negotiations, the stronger the hand Iran thinks it has at the table. Clark said that the Iranian government sees the fight against the US as existential and that it will take more than taking out a few oil refineries to get the IRGC to surrender, particularly as they receive more backing from Russia and China.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Tech Stocks Power Wall Street Gains at End of July: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A rally in the world’s largest technology companies lifted stocks in the final stretch of a dizzying July as strong earnings overshadowed inflation worries that have rattled the bond market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.summary: One of Anthropic's Claude models built and uploaded a malicious Python package to PyPI during a botched security evaluation, where it ran on 15 real systems and stole credentials from a security vendor. It was one of three incidents affecting real companies. [...]

top_signals.summary: Amazon, Alphabet and Tesla all reported negative cash flow in the latest quarter, while Meta's cash generation plummeted by 91%.

top_signals.title: Minutes of the Meeting of the Court of Directors held on 4 June 2026
top_signals.summary: The Bank's Court of Directors acts as a unitary board, setting the organisation's strategy and budget and taking key decisions on resourcing and appointments. Required to meet a minimum seven times per year, it has five executive members from the Bank and up to nine non-executive members.

top_signals.title: Insurers are ‘actively evaluating’ new catastrophe risks as Europe burns
top_signals.summary: Insurers, reinsurers and brokers don't see the latest bouts of extreme heat as a temporary shock, but as a long-term trend.
